description: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for four different model configurations as a function of the activated parameters ratio, which is expressed as a percentage. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", is linear and spans from 25% to 100%, with tick marks at regular intervals of 25%. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", is also linear and ranges from 11.5 to 14.0. The plot contains four distinct lines: a red dashed line with circular markers representing the "Transformer" baseline, which remains nearly constant at approximately 11.6 PPL across the entire range; a gray dashed line with square markers for "Only MoHD FFN", which starts at about 11.6 PPL at 100% and decreases to approximately 11.5 PPL at 25%; a dark blue line with circular markers for "Only MoHD ATTN", which begins at around 11.6 PPL at 100% and rises to approximately 12.1 PPL at 50% before sharply increasing to about 14.0 PPL at 25%; and a cyan line with 'x' markers for "MoHD ATTN + MLP", which starts at approximately 11.6 PPL at 100% and increases to about 13.1 PPL at 25%.
